Government ordered payment, still not paid. Court auctioned company's equipment and paid 115,206 RMB to employees. Defendant returned, confessed.

What crime? Likely "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration) which is a crime under Chinese law: "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". In examples, they used "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier example: "拒不支付劳动报酬". So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "逃匿" but that's not a crime per se. The main crime is refusal to pay wages. So single crime.
